title: Farmers, farms and crops: {area}
residence_note: Farmers are counted where they live; farms and dunam where the farm is. Irrigated includes mixed farms.
none: No farm is registered in this area yet.
harvest_note: An estimate only: registered dunam times a typical yield per dunam (set in the Crop register). Weather, water and disease change the real harvest.
matrix: Land per crop in each governorate (dunam)
matrix_dist: Land per crop in each district (dunam, the 6 largest crops)
foot: Source: the Jutyar farm register, farms registered by farmers in the Jutyar app. It counts registered farms only; it is not a census.
